name: sky-gradient-clock
description: 全天候天空色温渐变可视化
interaction: As the hours pass, a horizontal gradient bar shifts through the full spectrum of natural daylight—from pre-dawn indigo through golden sunrise, midday azure, amber sunset, and deep twilight. The current time is marked by a luminous sun/moon indicator that travels along the gradient, while hovering reveals the precise color temperature (in Kelvin) and a poetic name for that moment of sky. Clicking any point on the bar scrubs through the 24-hour cycle, letting users explore how the sky's chromatic mood evolves minute by minute.
